description: A command-line tool for Jev. It turns Jev's typed questions into commands you can pipe into and gate CI on: verify claims against evidence, screen text for prompt injection, classify, extract, rerank, match, route and compact agent transcripts.
how_used_jev: Each command sends content and a closed set of questions to Jev and prints a probability for every answer. Exit code 2 means a chosen condition matched, so a claim check or an injection screen can block a CI job or a hook. A Claude Code plugin in the repo uses jev compact in place of Claude Code's compaction summary.
